title: The Ages of Thought
tagline: Ten ages, and the people who argued their way from one to the next.
thesis: A philosopher is not a point on a line. He is a reader of the dead and an argument with the living, and both show as lines on a map.
blurb: The same 2,600 years as The Long Argument, drawn rather than told. Ten ages down the left, time across the middle, and a line between two philosophers whenever one taught, read or argued with the other. It opens on the six who moved the most and widens from there.
